long_biography.plain_text:
Specialty Metals Processing brought Michael Miniea back from an early retirement. He bought the struggling steel plant with his wife, Becky, and divided the work between them: he ran operations while she managed finance and sales. They restored profitability and expanded the business, whose services included polishing and grinding metal for industrial customers. Ryerson acquired the company in 2021.

At Penn Ohio Self Storage, Miniea supported the painting of manager Michael DeBonis, buying some of his work and asking him to decorate the office. A purchase of his own also changed the business: after hiring a truck to bring a chandelier home from Colorado, Miniea added a U-Haul dealership to the storage operation.

confidence.reason: The turnaround and division of work are directly described by Miniea and broadly corroborated by SMP's own retrospective. Ryerson confirms the exit and processing specialism; U-Haul's original partner report supplies DeBonis and the dealership decision.
